Instructions for Use
Device description: The Kestrel Neuromodulation System is a sacral neuromodulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Kestrel Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5 T or 3.0 T
· Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.2 W/kg
· Device configuration: Therapy OFF
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Kestrel Neuromodulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 1.6 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
